page_title: Hoppy Copy: AI Writing, Email Marketing & Automation Platform

sources.entry: Happy Copy - Use AI to create powerful content for hundreds of different email campaigns, drips, newsletters and more—in seconds #paid

summary.name: Hoppy Copy
summary.one_liner: Hoppy Copy is an AI email marketing and content platform that drafts, designs, automates and sends newsletters and campaigns in a brand's voice.
use_cases: Drafting product launch and promo emails
Building welcome and sales email sequences
Repurposing blog posts and videos into emails
Monitoring competitor emails for offers and ideas
Managing email lists and automations from one place
summary.what_it_does: Hoppy Copy lets you preload a brand voice, connect blogs, RSS feeds and other sources, and have it generate newsletter content streams and full email drafts. Its AI writer offers built-in copywriting frameworks and sequences for launches, nurture and newsletters. It includes a spam checker, mobile-friendly design templates, and form and landing page builders. Users can send from Hoppy Copy or export to their own email service provider, and track opens, clicks and engagement with built-in analytics. Zapier integration is listed for syncing contacts.
notable: Brand voice and brand memory learned from your site, blogs and past content
Competitor email monitoring to inspire campaigns
Choice of multiple AI models (GPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini)
Managed tier where human experts write and send newsletters
caveats: Paid plans listed at $39 or $49 per month, with tiers limited by users, engines, brand voices and up to 3,000 subscribers on base plans
Free access is a 7-day trial; the page says no credit card is required
Managed and Enterprise tiers require booking a call; pricing for them is not listed
